name: The Ritz-Carlton, Laguna Niguel
insider_take: Perched dramatically on 150-foot bluffs overlooking the Pacific, this oceanfront sanctuary has hosted royalty and A-listers since 1984, including Princess Diana during her memorable 1990s California visit.
whats_special: This is the only Ritz-Carlton built directly on the ocean in Southern California, featuring two miles of pristine coastline and the exclusive Salt Creek Beach access. The property sits within the Dana Point Harbor area, known as the "Dolphin and Whale Watching Capital of the World," where gray whales migrate just offshore from December through April.
pro_tip: Book a cliffside room on floors 3-4 for the most spectacular unobstructed ocean views, and time your stay during the super bloom season (March-May) when the surrounding hillsides explode with wildflowers.
dont_miss: The resort's signature Beach Club with private cabanas, the award-winning Raya restaurant featuring Chef Richard Sandoval's coastal Mexican cuisine, and the nearby Dana Point Harbor's weekend farmers market. The hotel's location also provides easy access to the historic Mission San Juan Capistrano, just 10 minutes away.
pros: Spectacular clifftop location with panoramic Pacific Ocean views
Direct beach access to pristine Laguna Beach coastline
Legendary Ritz-Carlton service and luxury amenities
Championship golf course with oceanfront holes
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive location
Limited nearby dining options outside the resort
